Name: CoreSpeed
Tagline: One MCP for everything your agents need: apps, memory, tools
Description: CoreSpeed is an operating system for agents. Connect apps once and bring your accounts and shared or private memory to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other MCP agents. Use multiple accounts per app, including X, with web search, social research and media generation built in. CoreSpeed holds app credentials. Budgets, activity logs and Smart Approval (beta) keep agents in check. Planned: Agent Drive, Mail, Pay, sandboxes, and more. Everything your agents need, through one MCP endpoint.

Name: Smooth Recorder
Tagline: Mac screen recordings that look edited when you hit stop
Description: Smooth Recorder is a native Mac app for demos and tutorials. It zooms in where you click, smooths your cursor, adds captions on your Mac and puts it all on a nice background. Screenshots get the same features.

Name: Gemini 4 Argon
Tagline: Google's frontier model for careful reasoning & complex work
Description: Gemini 4 Argon is Google’s frontier AI model for complex, long-horizon professional work. It combines advanced reasoning, coding, multimodal understanding, and cybersecurity-defense capabilities, with support for up to 1 million output tokens. Designed for software engineering, finance, legal work, and enterprise research, it helps solve multi-step problems while Google gradually expands access through trusted testing and safety safeguards.

Name: WikiFix for Confluence
Tagline: Find and fix issues in your knowledge base
Description: WikiFix monitors your KB for issues like contradicting pages, duplicates and orphans, and fixes them in one click once you approve, so your team can trust what it reads or hears from AI.

Name: Blume 2.0
Tagline: The open-source docs framework for humans and agents
Description: Fast, AI-ready, and zero-config. Drop Markdown into a folder and ship a production-grade docs site with no app boilerplate to write or maintain. Free and open source, forever.

Name: opensend.cc
Tagline: The open source email platform that runs on your server
Topics: Email, Open Source, Developer Tools, GitHub
Description: opensend.cc is an open source email platform that runs on your server. It sends through your own AWS account, so your domain, your data and your sender reputation stay yours. You get a REST API and SDK, SMTP, templates, broadcasts, automations, audiences, webhooks and logs. One command installs it. No per-email pricing, no feature gates. Already on Resend? Change two lines and keep your code.

Name: Pass Designer
Tagline: Design Apple Wallet passes and see the real card
Description: Whether you’re creating passes for a local fitness center, a small music venue, a global airline, or a national coffee chain, Pass Designer makes it easy to craft and preview passes that reflect your business.

Name: Thinking Orbs
Tagline: Animated AI Status Indicator Component Library for React
Topics: Open Source, Artificial Intelligence, Design resources
Description: A React component library of animated AI agent status orbs. Thinking, searching, compacting and more, built with attention to detail on every state and variant.

Name: Octri.dev
Tagline: Generate customizable Docs, SDKs, MCP server, and monitoring
Description: Upload an OpenAPI spec and Octri generates a fully customizable documentation site, high-quality client SDKs in ten languages (TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Ruby, PHP, Java, Kotlin, Swift, Dart) and an MCP server so AI agents can call your API. The new part: every SDK reports its own production errors back, so you see integration failures before your users file tickets. GitHub sync regenerates everything on every merge.

Name: Sente
Tagline: Talk to your coding agent
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: A coding agent you can talk to — in your terminal or on your phone. 1. Voice, both ways. Read one sentence (~10 sec) to enroll your voice. Consent-first; the delete key is yours. 2. 404 models on one account — Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek and more. OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible. 3. MIT open source: github.com/yukihamada/sente Japan-built: Tokyo region, JPY billing. Honest limits: metered, not unlimited. Monthly credits; top up if you go over. We never clone a voice that isn't yours.

Name: ChatGPT Space
Tagline: Create, collaborate, and build together with AI in Space
Description: ChatGPT Space is a shared canvas for creating, planning, and collaborating with AI. Add links, files, and ideas to build a living source of context, then work with ChatGPT to turn them into plans, docs, apps, and more - keeping your team aligned in one place.

Name: Snapset
Tagline: Save and restore your entire Mac workspace in an instant
Description: Apps, window positions, browser tabs, even the folders you had open. A Mac menu bar app that remembers your entire workspace, and rearranges it automatically when you plug into a different display.

Name: JOGAK
Tagline: Make everyday vlogs with less editing
Description: JOGAK is a vlog camera that joins the clips you record in shooting order. Capture everyday moments, review your timeline, adjust what you need, and save a finished video diary. Available for iPhone and Android. Free to download, with an ad option to export without the JOGAK logo.

Name: Angebotsmeister
Tagline: Speak the job to send a quote
Description: Angebotsmeister turns what a tradesperson says on site into a quote: proper line items, prices that show where they came from, a PDF the customer can accept online. One tap then makes the invoice. Built for the German trades, in German, free to start.

Name: Calnio
Tagline: Two-way sync between Notion and Apple Calendar
Description: Calnio syncs Notion tasks and Apple Calendar both ways, real iCloud events with alerts, not a read-only webcal feed. Edit in either app, the other updates. Free, built by an indie dev and hosted on a Raspberry Pi at home.

Name: Rival Workshop
Tagline: A bookshelf app to manage every skill your agents read
Topics: Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence, Vibe coding
Description: The Workshop app shows every skill in your repo as a book on a shelf: the spine is what Claude Code, Codex or Cursor reads before every task, and a bookend marks where each one stops. Switch skills off, make them run only when asked, rewrite them with Claude Code, and add good ones from the web after a safety check. One node command, and it runs on your computer. Includes 150 editable skills and Brief. One payment: $79 until Oct 31, 2026 (11:59 pm Pacific), then $149.

Name: Cupola
Tagline: Apple calendar, reminders & notes, together in one app
Description: One Mac app for your Apple Calendar, Apple Reminders and Apple Notes, with all three a hover away in your MacBook notch and as a standalone Mac app. Try it free for 7 days, then $20 once.

Name: Pixel Soup
Tagline: Dithered live wallpapers your Mac cooks up itself
Topics: Mac, Menu Bar Apps, Graphics & Design
Description: Pixel Soup makes your Mac's wallpaper for you. Pick a shape, a palette and a dither style, and it draws it live on your GPU, then keeps it gently moving behind your icons or freezes it as a still. Drop in a photo and it dithers that too. Hit one button for a random new wallpaper, or let it serve a fresh one every hour. No account, no tracking, no subscription. One payment and it is yours.

Name: Sellio
Tagline: AI customer support in one shared inbox powered by AI agents
Description: AI customer support in one shared inbox: live chat, WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram, and email. AI agents trained on your docs, plus tickets and analytics.

Name: Capybara Court
Tagline: Tiny disputes, gently settled by a capybara judge
Description: Two people answer the same four questions about a small dispute. Each side is sealed; only Judge Cappy, a capybara, reads both. The ruling opens on both phones at once, fault never 100 to 0. Alone? Post to the gallery, names covered. It all shreds in 30 days.
